get.description:
Published words of the current school whose most recent answer was wrong.

Each direction counts on its own: a word is difficult in a direction when the latest
answer in that direction was wrong. `directions` lists those directions.

Published words of the current school, in course order.

``with_clip`` keeps only words that have a clip.
Years, lessons and lists of the current school that have published words, with counts.

post.description: Upload one clip for a word. It is converted in the background; poll the job.

Cut the start and/or end off a clip. The shortened copy takes the clip's place in the
background and the original is archived, so the trim can be undone. Poll the job.
Upload a long video. It is converted and split on the pauses in the background.
Detect the cut points again, for example with the other method. Replaces the segments.

Cut each segment into a clip: for an existing word (replace or add as extra), or for
a new word on the chosen year and list (created as a draft unless ``publish``).
Make a new invite link. The old link stops working.
Move every student of a group, e.g. 'Jaar 1 · dinsdag' → 'Jaar 2 · dinsdag'.

Give a member of the school a temporary password.

Teachers can reset students; admins anyone in the school except a superadmin.
Add someone to the school: an existing account, or a new one with a temporary password.
